dedupe_keys.name: flame field level asset mapping dataset for england s agricultural sector v2 0

description: FLAME maps farmed landholdings and their ownership across England. The Zenodo record says version 2.0 joins Rural Payments Agency land parcels, HM Land Registry ownership polygons and June Agricultural Census statistics, giving farm boundaries, ownership boundaries, cropping and land use attributes, farm business entities matched with language processing and rules, area and overlap indicators, and administrative and environmental overlays. It was published in June 2025 by researchers at the University of Oxford under the CC BY-NC 4.0 licence, free to download for non-commercial use as one Excel file of about 43 MB. Coverage is England. Caveats: entity matching is automated and can be wrong, and commercial use is not allowed. For simulation it links farm assets to owners for hazard exposure, financial risk and supply chain studies of English agriculture. Related catalogue records include the Spatial Finance Initiative GeoAsset databases and the UK Farm Business Survey.
